Pinned-tree grep for the page mode, link ownership and terminal_link_click confirms no replacement combined check in these suites. Fix direction: port the Settings-to-agent-and-tab program-observed ownership case to grid terminals using the existing real mouse-mode fixture and ordered acknowledgement, retaining positive beside-link and all-mode checks. This does not propose restoring xterm-specific bookkeeping or reporting the pre-range secondary-button issue as introduced here. Suggested bucket: other (test-only integration-coverage loss).
